name: Tidy Fields
summary: Arrange industry plots and unlock their full growth potential.
description: Arrange plots in compact rows in selected directions while keeping the entrance road clear. Supports crop, livestock, cotton and rubber farms and forests. Newly generated expandable industries receive the maximum growth cap allowed by their predefined plots; current plot counts, growth requirements and production rules remain native.

zh_CN.name: 工厂地块规整
zh_CN.summary: 规整工厂地块，让可扩建产业拥有完整的成长上限。
zh_CN.description: 支持作物、牲畜、棉花、橡胶农场和伐木场的地块整理。用前后左右多选按钮选择范围，优先补齐行列、连片排列，避让门前横路，可重复整理。已合并产业最大成长上限：新生成的14类原版可扩建产业，上限设为全部预设地块数量；当前规模、成长条件和原版生产规则保持不变。
